periods.name: 卡邦克鲁诅咒
periods.description: After Sherlock split her, Carbuncle cursed Sherlock to die if he approaches Chhat and cursed her stolen life not to leave her by more than about fifteen kilometers. The former curse is lifted after Kinji's draw/win settlement.
